protected_invariants.heading: Phase 1 — Extract Scope
protected_invariants.text: Present the checklist and ask the developer to confirm or adjust before proceeding. Do not proceed to Phase 2 until confirmed.

protected_invariants.heading: Phase 2 — Gather and Read Proof
protected_invariants.text: For each category, read the actual code, tests, and config. Do not rely on filenames, commit messages, or assumptions.

protected_invariants.heading: Phase 3 — Deep Status Assessment
protected_invariants.text: | ❓ Unclear | Cannot determine from available proof — needs manual verification | Do not guess |

protected_invariants.heading: Tool Boundaries
protected_invariants.text: - forbidden: modifying code, running tests, deploying, or making changes without explicit developer approval; guessing scope from code alone when no spec is provided

protected_invariants.heading: Rules
protected_invariants.text: 1. **Demand context** — always ask for scope documents (pitch, HLD, OAS, tickets) and proof sources (code, tests, config). Do not guess scope from code alone.

protected_invariants.heading: Rules
protected_invariants.text: 2. **Confirm scope first** — present the extracted checklist for developer approval before gathering proof. Do not skip this gate.

protected_invariants.heading: Rules
protected_invariants.text: 3. **Read the code** — inspect actual files, diffs, and test bodies. Never rely on filenames or commit messages as proof.

protected_invariants.heading: Rules
protected_invariants.text: 5. **No false greens** — if you cannot verify an item from proof, mark it ❓ or 🟡, never ✅.

protected_invariants.heading: Rules
protected_invariants.text: 6. **Go deeper than the checklist** — the gap analysis must surface things the developer did not explicitly ask about.

protected_invariants.heading: Rules
protected_invariants.text: 8. **Evidence with references** — every status must cite a file, line, commit, or test. No hand-waving.

protected_invariants.heading: Example Follow-Up
protected_invariants.text: > The scope checklist is missing the webhook callback endpoint from the HLD. Add it and re-run Phase 3 for that item only.

protected_invariants.heading: Evaluation Rubric
protected_invariants.text: | No false greens | Unverifiable items are marked ❓ or 🟡, never ✅ |

protected_invariants.heading: Evaluation Rubric
protected_invariants.text: | Output contract | The report follows the required output format with all sections populated |
